apps.name: Pi-hole
apps.description: Network-wide ad blocking DNS server

apps.name: CrewAI Studio

Define your first AI agent (role, goal, backstory)
Create a task for the agent

Select your language and click Continue

credential.via: Admin -> Settings -> Users -> create API user (token shown once)

tools.name: listmonk_add_subscriber
tools.description: Add ONE subscriber to list(s). Bulk CSV import is done in the Listmonk admin UI.

preconfirm_subscriptions.description: true = skip double opt-in (subscriber confirmed immediately)

tools.name: listmonk_create_campaign
tools.description: Create an email campaign (does NOT send; use listmonk_send_campaign)

from_email.description: sender address, e.g. 'AppVault <noreply@example.com>'. Must match the configured FromEmail domain for delivery.

body.description: email body (HTML for richtext/html, markdown for markdown)

template_id.description: template id (optional; default template used when omitted)

status.description: running = send now; scheduled = send at campaign send_at
